mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 62 degrees with clear skies at Badger Prairie County Park, and we are seeing a Waning Crescent moon. Tonight will cool down to an overnight low of 49 degrees with no rain in the forecast.
The City of Verona has announced a new leaf vacuum truck to improve fall collection, and the Building Inspection Department has updated guidelines for residential solar projects.
We have plenty to look forward to, including Yoga at Insight Wellness today, followed by various trivia nights at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and The Bogey Factory tomorrow.
In a notable report, on October 3, a Verona officer stopped a vehicle for expired registration and arrested the driver for being a felon in possession of a stolen firearm.
Stop by today to enjoy our flavor of the day, Chocolate Caramel Twist. We are open until 10 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to grab a scoop.
